verdict.rationale: Policy-as-code gating is a fair axis for an infrastructure-as-code tool, but the evidence documents no built-in policy engine or policy check that blocks non-compliant changes before apply. The `tofu plan` previews, saved plan files and `tofu test` assertions are adjacent features: tests create real infrastructure and check conditions, and they do not enforce policy on a plan before apply. Feeding plans to external policy tools would be a user-side workaround and earns no credit.

support.subject: As a devops-lead, I can enforce policy-as-code checks that block non-compliant infrastructure changes before apply
